concepts.product_title: Aluminium Full Size 457mm x 660mm (18" x 26") Sheet Pans
concepts.primary_text:
Even bakes, batch after batch.

This full-size aluminium sheet pan (457mm x 660mm) spreads heat evenly across the whole base, so trays come out consistent from front to back. Rolled edges for a proper grip when your hands are full.

Good, honest kit for busy kitchens. Free next day delivery on UK mainland orders over £54 inc VAT.
concepts.headline: Even heat, edge to edge
concepts.why_it_works: For a workhorse bakeware item the strongest pull is the reliable outcome - even bakes every time - which speaks straight to a busy kitchen's daily pain.
concepts.visual_direction: The aluminium sheet pan laid flat on a floured stainless bakery bench with unbaked bread rolls and a linen cloth beside it.

concepts.primary_text:
No cord, no trailing lead across the bench.

The KitchenAid cordless hand mixer lets you whip, stir and cream anywhere in the kitchen - no fighting for a socket mid-prep. Two stainless beaters click straight in.

A simple, straightforward solution to your kitchenware needs. Klarna and Trade Accounts available.
concepts.headline: Mix anywhere, no cord
concepts.why_it_works: The single biggest daily friction with a hand mixer is the cord and a scarce socket, so leading with the cordless fix names the exact problem this model removes.
concepts.visual_direction: The matte black cordless hand mixer resting on a wooden worktop beside a glass bowl of whipped cream and a few eggs.

concepts.product_title: Cambro 1380 x 600mm Camshelving Premium Mobile Unit
concepts.primary_text:
Worried metal racks rust and trap grime? This one won't.

The Cambro Camshelving Premium mobile unit is wipe-clean polypropylene - liquids and dirt can't get into crevices, and every part is dishwasher safe. Adjustable shelf heights in 100mm steps.

Honest catering storage that lasts. 30 day returns and Trade Accounts with a 30 day credit facility available.
concepts.headline: Wipe clean, won't rust
concepts.why_it_works: The main hesitation on a big-ticket shelving spend is durability and hygiene versus cheap metal wire, so killing the rust-and-grime worry head-on justifies the price.
concepts.visual_direction: The grey plastic Cambro shelving unit standing on its casters in a clean tiled dry-store, holding stacked catering containers and stock tins.
